_comment: Game Center leaderboards and achievements. ios/store/gamecenter.py creates them in App Store Connect; ids get the prefix kingwalk. (the page sends the short names: achieve() and reportProgress() in index.html). Images: node ios/scripts/art.js. Points add up to at most 1000. Challenges are friendly competitions on a leaderboard for a few days; their leaderboards only get scores from solves made then (reportProgress in index.html).
